text:
mika: Quick sync on the console quickstart banner + sample project stack. Noticed multiple users bounce from the empty-state because the banner pushes the checklist down. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/quickstart-banner-stack.png

leah: Flagging two problems: 1) visual hierarchy is confusing 5050 the banner competes with step 1; 2) on narrow view the banner CTA covers the progress indicator.

alex: On mobile we also lose the sample project thumbnails under the fold. Any chance we can float the banner as a dismissible toast instead of inline? That would keep the checklist visible.

priya: a11y points: dismiss button needs an accessible label (currently only an icon). Also color contrast on the CTA falls below 4.5:1 when the banner is narrow 5050 we should test at 14px and 18px.

jon: Idea: convert the banner into a compact strip that attaches to the bottom on mobile (sticky) and expands into a modal when tapped to show sample projects. Keeps checklist above the fold. We can gate behind a feature flag.

leah: UX trade 5050 sticky strip might be more discoverable but could be intrusive. We should prototype both: inline-docked vs sticky bottom sheet. Quick prototypes in Figma?

alex: I'll make two variants in Figma: "docked inline banner (compact)" and "sticky bottom sheet". Link after I push: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/quickstart-variants

priya: Microcopy: primary CTA on the strip should read `Try a sample project` not `Start`. Also add `Why samples?` a subtle helper link that expands to one sentence explaining value. New copy reduces friction.

mika: Good. Also let's reduce sample card count to 4 and prioritize by first-run success (chat, embeddings, rerank, code). Show a `See all` action.

jon: Engineering note: For bottom sheet we already have a modal component; reusing it will save time. But for sticky we need to ensure it doesn't block keyboard focus or screen readers. Use `aria-hidden` for content behind and trap focus within the sheet when open.

priya: Add aria-label to dismiss `Dismiss quickstart banner` and to the `See all` `Open sample projects list`. Also add role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" for the sheet. Use `aria-live` for ephemeral success messages when user creates a sample project.

leah: Accessibility QA: run with VoiceOver and NVDA on both variants. I can take initial pass and then run paired testing with a keyboard-only session.

alex: Implementation plan: feature flag `quickstart_sticky_sheet_v1`. Default to off for 100% of users while we build. Then experiment at 10% traffic. Jon, can you add toggle and telemetry events? Track events: quickstart_shown, quickstart_dismissed, sample_clicked, sample_created.

jon: Yep will add events and a small dashboard. Also add metric for keyboard open rate and screen-reader sessions if we can tag from the client.

mika: Small performance note: lazy-load thumbnails with low-res placeholders to avoid layout shift. Use srcset and sizes attributes for responsive images.

priya: Alt text guidance: briefly describe the sample project outcome, e.g., "Sample: Chat assistant that summarizes support tickets". Avoid generic "screenshot" alt copy.

leah: Visual tweak: reduce banner elevation and use a subtle outline to separate it from the checklist instead of heavy shadow. This helps users scan the checklist first.

alex: I'll push Figma variants by EOD and include developer notes for focus management and image sizes.

jon: I'll prototype the flag + telemetry on staging this week. Leah, can you schedule an a11y review for Friday?

leah: Yes, I'll block 1 hour Friday for VoiceOver + keyboard passes.

priya: I'll open the copy PR and include the accessible labels and the microcopy change.

mika: Action items summary: Alex -> Figma variants + dev notes; Jon -> feature flag + telemetry + staging prototype; Leah -> a11y testing + report; Priya -> copy PR + alt text; Mika -> file follow-up tickets and link designs. Aim for incremental rollout behind flag.

design-bot: Created draft ticket #5801 in product board: "Quickstart banner: sticky sheet vs inline dock + a11y fixes".

mika: Thanks all. Closing thread 600d
